svg.title: From One Injured Family to a Settlement Matrix
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-01-mass-tort-to-mdl-path; chapter number: 1; title: From One Injured Family to a Settlement Matrix; subtitle: How a mass tort becomes an MDL docket, step by step; chart type: process_flow; stages: step: 01; label: Mine single-family intake; value: Step 1; detail: The baby formula litigation started with one mother who lost a child and went to a firm that did not do mass torts; Stewart & Stewart turned one pressure cooker burn into a known seal-issue pattern.; step: 02; label: Front-load the medical records; value: Step 2; detail: By the time defendants get medical authorizations, Joseph Lyon's firm has already gathered most of the critical records that substantiate the case.; step: 03; label: Clear the JPML numerosity trigger; value: Step 3; detail: Searcy Law looks for 20 to 50 cases with hundreds or thousands expected; some MDLs form on fewer than 20, some petitions are denied, and venue cannot be banked on from oral argument.; step: 04; label: Fund leadership through a common fund; value: Step 4; detail: Executive committee of 4-5 and a steering committee of 2-3 up to 20 self-fund document review, depositions and experts; confirm co-counsel funding before committing.; step: 05; label: Bellwether pool sets the settlement matrix; value: Step 5; detail: Dolman Law Group describes 50 to 100 claims, maybe a few more, pulled from thousands to gather records and pick representative bellwether cases.; caption: A mass tort is the injury; the MDL is the payout vehicle where each plaintiff keeps an individual lawsuit after consolidated pretrial work.; assumptions note: Thresholds and committee sizes are attributed practitioner claims and vary by docket. Roberts tells MDL clients they each get their own trial, while Dolman says very few cases are ever tried.; note: Sources: Searcy Law Video (yIQ0NYXRsmQ), Dolman Law Group (qGQGuFYFCF8), Attorney Joseph Lyon (nUl1KZ2z_es), CW33 KDAF (hSl_yaMfnv0), Stewart & Stewart Attorneys (4iH4c_z7Iw0), Roberts & Roberts Law Firm (XubmYzsLJEw).

text.title: From One Injured Family to a Settlement Matrix
text.tspan: From One Injured Family to a Settlement Matrix

circle.title: step: 01; label: Mine single-family intake; value: Step 1; detail: The baby formula litigation started with one mother who lost a child and went to a firm that did not do mass torts; Stewart & Stewart turned one pressure cooker burn into a known seal-issue pattern.

text.title: The baby formula litigation started with one mother who lost a child and went to a firm that did not do mass torts; Stewart & Stewart turned one pressure cooker burn into a known seal-issue pattern.

circle.title: step: 02; label: Front-load the medical records; value: Step 2; detail: By the time defendants get medical authorizations, Joseph Lyon's firm has already gathered most of the critical records that substantiate the case.

text.title: By the time defendants get medical authorizations, Joseph Lyon's firm has already gathered most of the critical records that substantiate the case.
text.tspan: By the time defendants get medical…

circle.title: step: 03; label: Clear the JPML numerosity trigger; value: Step 3; detail: Searcy Law looks for 20 to 50 cases with hundreds or thousands expected; some MDLs form on fewer than 20, some petitions are denied, and venue cannot be banked on from oral argument.

text.title: Searcy Law looks for 20 to 50 cases with hundreds or thousands expected; some MDLs form on fewer than 20, some petitions are denied, and venue cannot be banked on from oral argument.
text.tspan: Searcy Law looks for 20 to 50 cases…

circle.title: step: 04; label: Fund leadership through a common fund; value: Step 4; detail: Executive committee of 4-5 and a steering committee of 2-3 up to 20 self-fund document review, depositions and experts; confirm co-counsel funding before committing.

text.title: Fund leadership through a common fund
Executive committee of 4-5 and a steering committee of 2-3 up to 20 self-fund document review, depositions and experts; confirm co-counsel funding before committing.

circle.title: step: 05; label: Bellwether pool sets the settlement matrix; value: Step 5; detail: Dolman Law Group describes 50 to 100 claims, maybe a few more, pulled from thousands to gather records and pick representative bellwether cases.

text.title: Bellwether pool sets the settlement matrix
Dolman Law Group describes 50 to 100 claims, maybe a few more, pulled from thousands to gather records and pick representative bellwether cases.

Assumptions: Thresholds and committee sizes are attributed practitioner claims and vary by docket. Roberts tells MDL clients they each get their own trial, while Dolman says very few cases are ever tried.
